title: K1426 follow-up — expanding-window OOS partial cointegration hedging

spec.lookahead_rule: Train on [:t-1], apply hedge beta to return t via shift(1).

dm_squared_hedge_loss_pch_vs_ols.harvey_threshold_note: Use |t| > 3.0 for strong claim under multiple testing.
Use |t| > 3.0 for strong claim under multiple testing.

notes: OOS HE is computed from hedged daily returns, not in-sample spread variance.
EG-VECM hedge ratio equals stage-1 OLS beta here; alpha is omitted because OOS return hedge uses beta only.
DM uses squared hedged returns as variance-loss proxy; negative t means PCH lower variance than OLS.
Quarterly (63-day default) refit cadence is a compute tractability choice; parameters remain strictly lagged.
